title: Trove correspondence message
description: One line of correspondence/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the message was sent/received

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

chat.description: conversation key within the source: handle / group id (iMessage), thread subject (email), channel (Slack)

chat_name.description: display name for the chat (group names, channel topics)

sender.description: canonical author address; empty when from_me

text.description: the body (full fidelity — trimming is a read-time opinion)

subject.description: subject where the medium has one

service.description: transport detail: "iMessage"/"SMS", the email account address, the Slack workspace

labels.description: source-native labels/folders (Gmail INBOX, CATEGORY_*, …) — a read-time filter

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (iMessage guid, email Message-ID, Slack channel/ts); imports skip already-stored guids
